paras: Transform the driving experience of your Nissan 370Z with the race-inspired Xforce cat-back exhaust system. Precision-engineered from brushed finish 304 stainless steel, this system delivers the aggressive soundtrack the 370Z deserves.

The design starts with twin 2.5” piping that bolts directly to the factory post-cat flange. To handle engine movement and ensure long-term reliability, the system incorporates flex bellows immediately after the connection. From there, it merges into a single 3” section with a slip joint, offering both adjustability and optimal flow.
hl: Dual 2.5” piping merging into single 3” section with slip joint
Flex bellows for movement and durability
Hot dog resonators to smooth out tone
Twin rear mufflers with drone canisters
ft: Xforce Nissan 370Z Race Inspired Cat Back Exhaust System
